$comment: Workspace O1 contract inventory (docs/claude-workspace-o1-brief.md 'Required contract inventory'). One entry per contract in the AI Architecture Workspace extension (docs/architecture-workspace-v1.md, accepted contract head 2a019dc517f12a0984a1d2699408ce97f529a267). pinning_rule 'local' means: self-consistency (local digest) and fixture-schema validation only, no external cross-repo parity check -- see contract/pin.json's per-entry 'source' field and scripts/verify-schema-pin.mjs. pinning_rule 'sensei_pinned' means: canonical in globulario/sensei and pinned byte-for-byte via contract/workspace/sensei-pin.json (local digest + live cross-repo parity + schema validation, verified by npm run verify:pin) -- see docs/architecture-workspace-contracts-v1.md and contract/PARITY.md for the mechanism.

contracts.notes: Canonicalized in globulario/sensei by PR https://github.com/globulario/sensei/pull/121, merged as source commit 14381d5760099df5a99b9ecd3a565998a494b392 (docs/schemas/workspace/v1/workspace-identity-v1.schema.json, golang/architecture/workspacecontract). Sensei is the sole authority and producer; sensei-dashboard is a consumer only -- workspace identity is evidence, not admission, and this contract never certifies correctness or authorizes mutation.

Canonicalized in globulario/sensei by PR https://github.com/globulario/sensei/pull/121, merged as source commit 14381d5760099df5a99b9ecd3a565998a494b392 (docs/schemas/workspace/v1/workspace-admission-v1.schema.json) -- a closed external projection of the real admission.Decision/admission.Verification Go structs (golang/architecture/admission/admission.go). Sensei is the sole authority and producer; sensei-dashboard is a consumer only -- admission is permission to attempt, not correctness, and scope_only/scope_compliant never imply correctness_certified.
Binds one persistent primary-architect conversation thread. Governed sessions require an admission_reference (schema-enforced).
Binds one bounded worker or architect/reviewer attempt. Supports read-only runs without forcing mutation-only fields (worktree_id/expected_head_sha nullable).
Six independent completion_facts fields (worker_completed, tests_passed, ci_observed_green, sensei_completion_verified, architect_exact_sha_approval, human_merge_occurred) -- none implies another.
Four-state support enum (supported/unsupported/unknown/conditional) per capability -- a boolean is insufficient when support depends on runtime mode.
mcp_configured and mcp_verified are independent booleans -- configured MCP is not verified MCP, and provider readiness is not workspace admission.
Strict discriminated union over 18 event kinds (architecture-workspace-v1.md §13), each with its own small bounded payload.
Request/result envelope pair (oneOf, mutually exclusive shapes), not a runner implementation. Automatic merge is not a representable action_kind.
